name: Rosemary AOT
description: Loads Rosemary AOT cache files (*.rmc) as relocated, symbolized host code.
longdescription: Opens the code cache `rosemary aot` writes: every Microlift chunk is mapped with its relocations applied, host imports become externs, each region gets `region_<guest va>` (entry) and `region_<guest va>_body` (link target) functions, and the guest code map becomes comments.
author: Rosemary contributors
